nodes.name: Get Existing URLs
nodes.notes: Reads the whole sheet just to pass its 'url' column to callscout as known_urls, so /discover can skip candidates already tracked.

nodes.name: Build Discover Request
nodes.notes: SEED_URLS is the one thing you maintain by hand -- swap in your own real funder/directory pages.

nodes.name: Discover Funding Calls
nodes.notes: Replaces the Tavily 'Web Search' + Firecrawl 'Fetch Page' tool nodes entirely. Set the URL to your deployed callscout's /discover endpoint (see DEPLOY.md). Credential: HTTP Header Auth, header name 'X-API-Key', value = the CALLSCOUT_API_KEY set on the deployment. A JSON-array response is auto-split into one item per opportunity by n8n's HTTP Request node -- no separate Split Out node needed. Raise the 180s timeout further if a seed page yields many candidates.

nodes.name: Looks Like Call?
nodes.notes: Drops anything callscout's looks_like_call flag marked false -- a page that doesn't read as a live, open call. Precision-first default matching callscout's own philosophy (a wrong row is worse than a missing one). To review these by hand instead of discarding them, swap this Filter for an IF node and route the false branch to its own 'needs review' tab.

nodes.name: Classify (Anthropic)
nodes.notes: Replaces the LangChain agent + Structured Output Parser: a plain, single-shot call to Anthropic's Messages API per surviving candidate (not an agentic tool loop -- there's nothing left for it to fetch or search, callscout already did that deterministically). Reuses your existing 'Anthropic account 11' credential via n8n's Predefined Credential Type auth. If your n8n version doesn't offer 'Anthropic API' in the HTTP Request node's Predefined Credential Type list, switch authentication to Header Auth with header 'x-api-key' = your Anthropic key instead.

nodes.name: Parse Classification + Merge
nodes.notes: Combines callscout's deterministic fields (date/amount, carried through unchanged) with the classifier's judgment fields. Falls back to a flagged, honest 'classification_failed' row rather than silently dropping a candidate if Anthropic's response isn't valid JSON.

nodes.name: Normalize Deadline
nodes.notes: Unchanged from the original workflow's node of the same name, other than reading from the merged fields above -- never fabricates a placeholder deadline, honestly flags deadline_was_estimated instead.

nodes.name: Upsert to Google Sheet
nodes.notes: Same sheet/columns as before. field_confidence and classification_failed aren't written to the sheet by default -- add columns for them if you want that audit trail visible there too.
